alternatives: Mảnh ren rách (not adopted: foregrounds a fragment)
glossary.rationale: Encaje is lace, and passages 1.10–1.11 identify a wide lace flounce decorating the wedding dress before it catches and tears. Dải ren is therefore a contextual Vietnamese rendering of that ornament, while rách keeps the physical tear and its symbolic resonance without explaining the bride’s decision in the title. Mảnh would foreground a detached fragment, and a generic ribbon would lose the lace material.
The lace is both a specific garment trimming and a repeated fragile/strong image. Keep it distinct from the satin dress and the tulle veil.

alternatives: ren Alençon / rộng một phần ba vara
glossary.rationale: The original’s historical Alenzón spelling is retained in Spanish; the Vietnamese uses the established French place name. RAE defines tercia as one third of a vara. Retain the unit and explain in notes, rather than silently convert a locally variable historical measure into an exact centimeter value.

glossary.draft_rendering: khăn mantilla / vải tuyn / sa tanh
alternatives: khăn trùm ren / màn tuyn / lụa sa tanh
glossary.rationale: Keep the three textiles and uses distinct. Mantilla is identified by the text’s action of putting it over the head; no unsupported lace material is added to that particular garment.

glossary.draft_rendering: những viên đá quý cổ trong bộ trang sức cưới
alternatives: đá quý cổ của bộ trang sức cưới
glossary.rationale: Provisional contextual reading of the bridal jewels. The singular/collective roca is not securely resolved as a specific mineral or cut by the modern RAE entry; do not confidently claim diamond or rock crystal. A historical costume/jewelry source is still needed.

alternatives: một khoang tàu đầy hoa cam
glossary.rationale: Probably a transport compartment in context, but the Spanish does not explicitly name a train. The draft leaves the vehicle unspecified; the logistics are subordinate to the extravagant display.
Retain the narrator’s framing of the refusal as an enigma. A fully literal word-puzzle gloss could distract from the figurative use.

glossary.draft_rendering: trong chớp mắt, vừa đủ thốt tiếng Giêsu
glossary.rationale: The idiom means an instant; retain its religious utterance as well as the temporal meaning, but evaluate whether the explanatory doubling is too obtrusive.

glossary.draft_rendering: tính khí hung bạo / tính nết hung hãn, chua cay
alternatives: dữ dằn / hung tợn, cay nghiệt
glossary.rationale: The first draft’s nóng nảy underweighted the warning. Corrected after adversarial AI feedback. Do not go beyond the text to assert a documented act of physical abuse or translate it as vũ phu.

glossary.source_term: se alzó un telón / apareció desnuda un alma
glossary.draft_rendering: một bức màn được kéo lên / một tâm hồn trần trụi
alternatives: màn sân khấu kéo lên / tâm hồn lộ trần
glossary.rationale: Theatrical exposure of character is paired with tearing textile; keep the image rather than replace it with an abstract diagnosis.

Spoken refusal/assent are quoted in Vietnamese. Without the quotes, tiếng không rõ ràng can be read as an unclear sound, reversing the force of a clear refusal. The source’s corresponding italics are recorded in source-check metadata.

decisions.proposal: Transcribe spoken no/sí as unmarked Vietnamese không/có.
decisions.outcome: Rejected; quote “không” and “có” throughout the vows/refusal context.
decisions.rationale: An unmarked không before rõ ràng accidentally reads as negating clarity. This was a substantive ambiguity, now corrected.

decisions.outcome: Corrected to tính khí hung bạo after independent AI adversarial feedback.
decisions.rationale: The weaker term softened the bride’s warning; the revised term does not invent a witnessed physical assault.

decisions.proposal: Break the elaborate imagined ceremony into short modern paragraphs.
decisions.outcome: Rejected; preserve the historical witness’s long accumulating paragraphs and narrator’s imagined status.
decisions.rationale: The narrator did not attend the wedding; her imagined social spectacle must not become eyewitness testimony.

decisions.proposal: Explain the fiancé with a modern psychiatric or domestic-abuse label.
decisions.outcome: Rejected; keep Micaelita’s reported observations, suspicion and resolve without new diagnosis.
decisions.rationale: The original centers a woman’s right to refuse and the meaning she assigns to a moment, not a clinical fact claim.

decisions.proposal: Silently convert tercia to approximately 28 cm.
decisions.outcome: Not adopted; retain tercia with a source-backed glossary definition.
decisions.rationale: Exact historical measurement varies; a rounded modern value belongs in a qualified note if later added.

decisions.outcome: Anh không buông ra những lời ấy
decisions.rationale: No llegó á tanto describes an aborted insult; chưa adds a not-yet implication which the source does not establish.

decisions.proposal: giận dữ, cứng rắn, khinh miệt
decisions.outcome: giận dữ, khắc nghiệt, khinh miệt
decisions.rationale: In this sequence dureza is harshness, not neutral or admirable firmness.

decisions.outcome: khung cảnh xã hội nơi chuyện xảy ra
decisions.rationale: Medio ambiente includes the social setting and constraints, not only the onlookers.

decisions.proposal: khách khứa tan, hôn lễ cũng tan theo.
decisions.outcome: khách khứa tan, cuộc kết duyên cũng tan theo.
decisions.rationale: Enlace is the union as well as the wedding: retain the parallel collapse of gathering and projected marriage, not merely an ended ceremony.

decisions.proposal: quà của ông anh rể sắp cưới
decisions.outcome: quà của ông anh rể tương lai
decisions.rationale: Use the ordinary Vietnamese future-kinship expression without changing who gives the bracelets.

decisions.proposal: Lễ cưới đã vào hàng, đôi uyên ương tiến lên theo người đỡ đầu
decisions.outcome: Nghi lễ đã được sắp đặt, đôi uyên ương tiến lên theo những người đỡ đầu
decisions.rationale: The ceremony is being organized, not literally standing in a line. Preserve the plural wedding sponsors.

decisions.proposal: Cô dâu trở bệnh à? Cô ấy nói “không” sao? Không thể nào... Nhưng có thật không? Chuyện gì thế này!...
decisions.outcome: Cô dâu đổ bệnh à? Cô ấy nói ‘không’ sao? Không thể nào... Nhưng có thật không? Thật là một màn!...
decisions.rationale: Remove an unintended relapse implication, distinguish nested quotation levels, and retain the crowd’s final gossipy exclamation rather than repeating its opening question.

decisions.proposal: Ba năm sau — khi gần như chẳng còn ai nhớ chuyện đám cưới của Micaelita, tôi gặp cô
decisions.outcome: Ba năm sau — khi gần như chẳng còn ai nhớ chuyện đám cưới của Micaelita — tôi gặp cô
decisions.rationale: Close the Vietnamese parenthesis to clarify the three-year transition; the historical Spanish punctuation stays unchanged.

decisions.proposal: tôi nghe đúng cái tiếng vải rách ấy
decisions.outcome: tôi nghe cái tiếng rách toạc không lẫn vào đâu được
decisions.rationale: Render the distinctive sound of tearing without a demonstrative that suggests a sound previously mentioned.

decisions.proposal: một bức màn được vén lên
decisions.outcome: một bức màn được kéo lên
decisions.rationale: Make the upward theatrical curtain movement more explicit while preserving the exposed soul image.

decisions.proposal: Tiếng “không” ấy trào ra ngoài ý định
decisions.rationale: Make the unplanned utterance idiomatic while retaining the following paradox of speaking to oneself for everyone to hear.

decisions.proposal: Họ sẽ chẳng bao giờ tin.
decisions.outcome: Nói ra, họ cũng chẳng bao giờ tin.
decisions.rationale: Preserve the counterfactual answer to why she did not explain the incident, rather than sounding like a simple prediction about the future.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Roca antigua is still rendered generally as antique precious stones. The precise historical jewelry material/cut and singular or collective force have not been established; a diamond or rock-crystal identification would be unsupported.

The rendering of un decir Jesús retains both an instant and the religious utterance. That explains the idiom but slightly overweights Micaelita’s conversational phrase. No more economical alternative was adopted without losing either aspect.

The accumulating ceremony paragraph preserves the social display and imagined frame, but its Vietnamese breath groups and register remain uneven. The local repairs do not resolve the entire long-period cadence.
The historical unit tercia remains in the text with an editorial glossary definition. This avoids an unsupported precise conversion but may interrupt an unannotated Vietnamese reading.

selection_limit: This is a limited editorial feasibility pilot, not evidence of an absent Vietnamese translation or verified reader demand. The Translation Gap Atlas retains its bounded evidence; an AI quality score does not establish a reason to scale production.

additional_adversarial_read.limitation: The additional agent read is correlated AI evidence and does not count as an independent qualified human review. No new approval authority or score increase is inferred.
